tunables.name: SCHEMA_VERSION
tunables.reason: format/era version stamp: the version a stored record, wire message or table was written at; changing it is a format change guarded by its own version test, not tuning

tunables.name: HASH_SEED
tunables.reason: mulberry32 seed-hash constant: part of the hash format, changing it re-rolls every seeded town (pinned by the town digests), not tuning

tunables.name: HASH_MUL
tunables.reason: mulberry32 seed-hash multiplier: part of the hash format, changing it re-rolls every seeded town (pinned by the town digests), not tuning

tunables.name: HASH_ROT_LEFT
tunables.reason: mulberry32 seed-hash rotate amount: part of the hash format, not tuning

tunables.name: HASH_ROT_RIGHT
tunables.reason: mulberry32 seed-hash rotate amount (32 minus the left rotate): part of the hash format, not tuning

tunables.name: STEP
tunables.reason: mulberry32 state increment: part of the PRNG's definition, changing it re-rolls every seeded town, not tuning

tunables.name: MIX_A
tunables.reason: mulberry32 output-mix shift: part of the PRNG's definition, not tuning

tunables.name: MIX_B
tunables.reason: mulberry32 output-mix shift: part of the PRNG's definition, not tuning

tunables.name: MIX_OR
tunables.reason: mulberry32 output-mix OR mask: part of the PRNG's definition, not tuning

tunables.name: MIX_C
tunables.reason: mulberry32 output-mix shift: part of the PRNG's definition, not tuning

tunables.name: UINT32
tunables.reason: 2^32: scales the PRNG's unsigned 32-bit output to [0,1), a number of the integer width, not tuning

tunables.name: SEED_WEALTH_STEPS
tunables.reason: the wealth is keyed into the town's seed string to a hundredth: part of the seed format (changing it re-rolls every town), not tuning

tunables.name: HALF
tunables.reason: one half: the centre of a unit interval, a mathematical constant, not tuning
